page.overview:
Who is Merchant Hawker?

Hawker is a merchant found in several locations, selling different items at each location. He has two shops, a general and apparel shop. The general shop has both dine in and take out food as available items for the avatar to buy and use while the apparel shop has clothing items related to the areas he can be found at.

Hawker fights using the default World Tour NPC moveset, he throws wrenches, knives and molotov cocktails as projectiles and attacks with straight punches and drop kicks, he also can teleport using ninjitsu techniques.
